subject: general
question: The decision of the ______________ will be considered as final in case there is a dispute over the disqualifications of members of either house of the Parliament.
solution:
The correct answer is__** **__**President.**

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The Constitution of India provides certain disqualifications under which a person shall be disqualified for being elected as a member of Parliament.
 
• On the question whether a member is subject to any of the disqualifications provisions, **the president’s decision is final.**
 
• Prior to giving any decision on any such question,** the President shall get the judgement of the Election Commission and shall act according to such opinion.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **Article 101**: Vacation of seats of members of Parliament
 
• **Article 102**:Provisions for **Disqualifications of Members of Parliament.**
 
• **Article 103: Decision on questions as to disqualifications of members.**
 
• **Article 104: Penalty for sitting and voting before making oath or affirmation under article 99 or when not qualified or when disqualified**
